Clone the Repository Open your terminal and run the following command to clone the project: git clone https://github.com/DrittesPhantom/BlazorWebAppTemplate cd your-repo-name 2. Install Workloads Install the wasm-tools workload ba running: dotnet workload install wasm-tools --skip-manifest-update --configfile src/NuGet.Config 3. Restore Dependencies Restore the NuGet packages using the .NET CLI: dotnet restore 4. Run the Application Navigate to the main project directory and start the development server: dotnet run --project src/Template.UI/Template.UI.csproj Once started, open your browser and navigate to https://localhost:5098. 📝 Building the Documentation Locally If you want to preview changes made to these markdown files locally, ensure you have the DocFX CLI installed, then run: docfx docs/docfx.json --serve ↩ Back to Main Website
